dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Welcome to my humble shop! We have some new items in store, if you would be so kind as to take a look at them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got some treasure I want to sell.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Oh, what rare objects have you found this time? Let me have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Linlang about the Dragonbone Orb.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: If what you see is true, this is a truly amazing relic.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: But from a cursory examination, I can't find anything evidently special about it. Perhaps it requires extensive use to show its qualities...

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: The way I see it, it does seem that the wondrous properties you ascribe to it might be a tad... exaggerated. Perhaps it was simply something entrusted to you by those who had failed in their task.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Don't take it to heart, though. I'm just saying what's coming to my mind.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: This is quite the common occurrence in our line of work, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Also, I believe that you did not keep this in sealed storage — it does seem like there is some wear and tear on its surface already.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: I'm afraid that there will be some price reduction on that front, too.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: How does 80,000 Mora sound? I can add 5 Bountiful Years on as specialty dishes as well.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: I believe that this is a good price.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: To be honest, I would consider the story behind it more valuable than its capabilities.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: I suspect that this might be of much interest to our storytellers and opera troupes, or perhaps the great men and women of Yujing Terrace.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: It would be quite the ancient showpiece of a relic even if I were to simply mount it on our shop counter.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: My, that's quite forward of you. Well then, here's you Mora.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: If you should find any other such treasures, we are always awaiting your patronage.

choices.text: Let me think about it a bit more.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: No problem. After all, you should always check the goods — I mean, the prices — when you're planning to sell precious relics.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: You can come to me again once you've mulled the matter over.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Oh, have you considered your options?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: I'll take that item for 80,000 Mora and 5 Bountiful Years.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: Thank you for your patronage. Here's your Mora.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: If you should find any other such treasures, we are always awaiting your patronage.

choices.text: Let me think about it one more time.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: No problem. After all, you should always check the prices on the market when you're planning to sell precious relics.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: You can come to me again once you've mulled the matter over.
